subject: religious-studies
title: Symbols and Sacred Places
welcome_lead: Discover the symbols, buildings and sacred spaces of the world's great religions.
meta_desc: KS3 Religious Studies adventure on religious symbols and places of worship.
final_note: You can now recognise the key symbols and buildings of major world religions.

concepts.def: Hindu temple where deities are worshipped.

walkthroughs.body_html: Each religion has key symbols: the cross (Christianity), the crescent and star (often used with Islam), the Star of David (Judaism), the Om (Hinduism), the Khanda (Sikhism) and the Dharma Wheel (Buddhism). Symbols help believers express identity and faith.

Different religions gather in different buildings: Christians in churches, Muslims in mosques, Jews in synagogues, Hindus in mandirs, Sikhs in gurdwaras, and Buddhists in temples or viharas. Each space is designed for prayer, community and learning.
When visiting any place of worship, it is important to be respectful: dress modestly, be quiet, and follow local customs such as removing shoes (gurdwara, mosque, mandir) or covering your head.
